w:r.w:t: Tomato Paste is made from finest, vine-ripened tomatoes, which are carefully processed to capture the true essence of this beloved fruit then concentrating it to 28-30°Brix by evaporation under vacuum. The result is a rich and full-bodied tomato paste. It is classified as a NON-GMO (genetically modified organism) product.
The paste does not contain any preservatives, colors or flavors.
Tomato Paste is filled in 220kgs aseptic bags in conical/PPL steel drums.
24 months from the date of production stored at ambient temperature.
The major use of Tomato paste is in the formation of ketchups. It's used in certain gravy recipes to add a robust tomato flavor and achieve the desired consistency
It is also used to create tangy and flavorful chutneys and dips to accompany various snacks
In any dish where you want to infuse a burst of tomato goodness without the extra liquid content, a small amount of tomato paste can be added to elevate the flavor.
